description: Unified MCP server for Gemini, Codex, Claude, Grok, Ollama, and Antigravity
name: io.github.Lykhoyda/ask-llm

environmentVariables.description: xAI API key for metered Grok requests; Ask LLM never enables billing or credits
environmentVariables.name: XAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Explicit Grok harness: xai-api (default) or grok-cli; no failover
environmentVariables.name: ASK_GROK_HARNESS

environmentVariables.description: Exact selected-harness model override (API default grok-4.6; CLI default grok-build; no fallback)
environmentVariables.name: ASK_GROK_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Grok reasoning effort: low, medium, high, or xhigh (default: high)
environmentVariables.name: ASK_GROK_REASONING_EFFORT

environmentVariables.description: xAI API output-token ceiling to bound accidental spend (default: 16384)
environmentVariables.name: ASK_GROK_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Timeout for xAI API requests in milliseconds (default: 600000)
environmentVariables.name: ASK_GROK_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Optional Cursor CLI credential for ask-cursor-agent; alternative to agent login
environmentVariables.name: CURSOR_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Timeout for model-neutral Cursor Agent harness calls (default: 600000)
environmentVariables.name: ASK_CURSOR_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Default Claude model alias or full model name (default: opus)
environmentVariables.name: ASK_CLAUDE_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Claude CLI fallback when Opus is overloaded or unavailable (default: sonnet)
environmentVariables.name: ASK_CLAUDE_FALLBACK_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Timeout for Claude CLI execution in milliseconds (default: 600000 = 10 minutes)
environmentVariables.name: ASK_CLAUDE_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Timeout for Antigravity (agy) execution in milliseconds (default: 300000 = 5 minutes)
environmentVariables.name: ASK_ANTIGRAVITY_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Set to '0' to drop agy's --sandbox flag if it blocks --add-dir context reads (default: sandbox on)
environmentVariables.name: ASK_ANTIGRAVITY_SANDBOX

environmentVariables.description: Timeout for CLI execution in milliseconds (default: 300000 = 5 minutes)
environmentVariables.name: GMCPT_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error (default: warn)
environmentVariables.name: GMCPT_LOG_LEVEL
